candidates.title: HybridGen: Efficient LLM Generative Inference via CPU-GPU Hybrid Computing
candidates.reason: CXL拡張tiered memory上でCPU-GPU協調attention、feedback scheduler、semantic-aware KV mappingを統合する。

candidates.title: NVLLM: A 3D NAND-Centric Architecture Enabling Edge on-Device LLM Inference
candidates.reason: FFN計算を3D NAND内へ移しattentionをlogic+DRAMで実行するstorage-compute co-design。

candidates.title: Scalable Processing-Near-Memory for 1M-Token LLM Inference: CXL-Enabled KV-Cache Management Beyond GPU Limits
candidates.reason: CXL memory内PNMへKV token selectionをoffloadし、1M-token級を対象にthroughput・energy・costを評価する。

candidates.title: HyMCache: A KV Cache Framework for Multi-Turn LLM Serving with CXL-Hybrid Memory
candidates.reason: CXL hybrid memoryでDRAMとSSD-backed storageを組み合わせ、multi-turn KV再利用を少DRAMで実現する。

candidates.title: RH+: Row-Hit-Optimized Scheduling for PIM-based LLM Inference
candidates.reason: PIM decodeのDRAM row cycle律速を分析し、row-hit維持stride schedulingで大幅speedupを示す。
